# Proofs are generated by a prover the player controls

Midnight generates proofs in a separate prover process that sees the witnesses, which in this game include a player's deck key and cards. Every player therefore proves on a machine they control; for the prototype that is the proof server in Docker on their own computer. No prover operated by us receives a player's witnesses, ever. Proving sits behind one interface (`Prover`) so that other local or user-controlled provers, including whatever the wallet may offer, replace Docker without touching the game. The onboarding requirement is fixed only after the wallet, prover and headset browser have been tested together.

## Considered options

- A prover hosted by us: convenient for players, but it would see every card, which is the thing the whole design exists to prevent.
